eli5.text: The assistant can now prepare Next.js websites for hosting directly in your local workspace, automatically installing the right tools, building the site, and packaging it for deployment. For developers using the desktop or web interfaces, this means Next.js projects follow a supported path without manual cloud configuration. A new preview system also validates embedded browser sizes to ensure videos render efficiently on screens up to 4K. These preparation and validation steps are in place to support smoother site publishing, but no user-facing features change until the hosting backends fully consume these new contracts.
